informal_statement: If \(f\) has derivative \(f'\) at \(x\), then \(S\circ f\) has derivative \(2\sin^2(f(x))f'\) there.
reason: `CMVBallCase.lean:490-512`: The source quantifies over arbitrary real \(f, f'\), and \(x\) with `HasDerivAt f f' x`. Its conclusion is the chain rule coefficient \(2\cdot \sin (f(x))^2\cdot f'\), exactly the author's statement, with no angle restriction.
